menu_note: Menu items and prices subject to change. Prices from the shop’s 2026 printed menu.
findings: The menu is a folded-flyer JPEG that can’t be searched, linked or read on a phone. Rebuilt as real text.
Opening and closing hours are not published anywhere, only “closed Sundays” on the job form.
The Boat House page has no hours-at-a-glance and no menu link.
Specials page is still showing 2023 promos.
Loyalty rewards are a long text page; hard to see what a given order earns.
questions: What are your closing times? Only “closed Sundays”, lunch 11–2:30 on weekdays and bar seating times were published, so the concept shows “to close”.
Is the $7.59 lunch special price from 2023 still current?
Your menu image lists an extra patty as $1.50 on the burger and $1.55 in the footer. Which is right?
Onion-ring substitution price was small print. Is it $3.10?
Should the online-order link be secure.microworks.com/tremont (the site’s link)?
May we reuse the photos from your site (bar, dining room, patio, storefront)?
about: Tremont House of Pizza first opened in 1978. The business has been locally owned and family run since its opening. We make all of our dough and sauces right at our restaurant.

honors.s: Eagle Times Best of the Best, Twin State Valley. Finalist, Best Pizza.

honors.t: Voted 5th Best Pizza in New Hampshire
honors.s: As listed on the shop’s own About page.

facts: In 2024 the shop took over the entire building: more dine-in seating plus a 13-seat, full-service bar.
Named the Boat House for the bar’s unique shape and decor.
A 12-tap reverse draft system, plus wine, cans and bottled beer.
A cocktail of the month for the non-wine, non-beer crowd.

sched.t: Bar seating opens at 3 PM and stays open to close.
Bar seating all day, 11 AM to close.
Every drink on the menu is available whenever the shop is open.

lunch.what: 8" grinder of your choice, half order of French fries and a 16 oz fountain drink.
lunch.when: 11 AM – 2:30 PM, Monday through Friday. Not available for delivery.
lunch.note: Price from the shop’s 2023 flyer; confirm it is current.

loyalty.rule: Every $1 spent earns 1 point, whether you call, order online or dine in. Points are stored by phone number. Just calling the store enrolls you.
rewards: Any burger basket with French fries
A new Porsche Cayenne GTS (the shop’s joke, kept as written)

community.s: A pesto, chicken, tomato and spinach pizza made at Tremont. In 2016, 20% of September sales went to CHAD for Team Nick. It was such a hit that it joined the menu. The pesto comes from VegetaBall’s in Claremont.
A one-month grinder special: 20% of sales were donated as gas cards for Norris Cotton Cancer Center patients. 127 were sold in October and $190.49 went to the NCCC.

careers.text: We are currently seeking counter help. Incentives include a Simple IRA retirement plan, discounted food, med bonus, PTO and cash tips.
